none: PAS CAM-79C0FF: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian, AD 364-378
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian, AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLOR[IA ROMANORVM]. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right, dragging captive and holding labarum. Mint is uncertain. Obverse legend reads [...]. Obverse shows diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 2.13g, diameter is 17.4mm, thickness is 1.6mm
